typedef long long ll;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<ll> vll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef vector<pii> vpii;

const ll MOD = 1000000007;

class Pair {
public:
    int a;
    int b;

    Pair(int a, int b) : a(a), b(b) {}

    bool operator<(const Pair& o) const {
        return a < o.a;
    }
};

ll power(ll x, ll y, ll p) {
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    ll res = 1;
    x = x % p;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y % 2 == 1) res = (res * x) % p;
        y = y >> 1;
        x = (x * x) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

void sort(vector<ll>& a) {
    sort(a.begin(), a.end());
}

class FastScanner {
public:
    string nextToken;
    int pos;
    string buffer;
    bool hasBuffer;

    FastScanner() : pos(0), hasBuffer(false) {}

    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
                if (!getline(cin, buffer)) {
                    return "";
                }
                pos = 0;
            }
            while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) {
                pos++;
            }
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) continue;
            string token;
            while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) {
                token += buffer[pos++];
            }
            return token;
        }
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    vi readArray(int n) {
        vi a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = nextInt();
        return a;
    }

    vll readlongArray(int n) {
        vll a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = nextLong();
        return a;
    }

    ll nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
};

void sieveOfEratosthenes(int n, vector<bool>& prime) {
    prime.assign(n + 1, true);
    for (int p = 2; p * p <= n; p++) {
        if (prime[p] == true) {
            for (int i = p * p; i <= n; i += p) prime[i] = false;
        }
    }
}

int log2(int x) {
    return (int)(log(x) / log(2));
}

ll binomialCoeff(ll n, ll r) {
    if (r > n) return 0;
    ll m = 1000000007;
    vector<ll> inv(r + 1);
    inv[0] = 1;
    if (r + 1 >= 2) inv[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) {
        inv[i] = m - (m / i) * inv[m % i] % m;
    }
    ll ans = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) {
        ans = (ans % m) * (inv[i] % m) % m;
    }
    for (ll i = n; i >= (n - r + 1); i--) {
        ans = (ans % m) * (i % m) % m;
    }
    return ans;
}

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return gcd(b, a % b);
}

vector<ll> facts(3000000);

ll mul(ll a, ll b) {
    return a * b % MOD;
}

ll add(ll a, ll b) {
    return (a + b) % MOD;
}

ll exp(ll base, ll pow) {
    if (pow == 0) return 1;
    ll half = exp(base, pow / 2);
    if (pow % 2 == 0) return mul(half, half);
    return mul(half, mul(half, base));
}

ll modInv(ll x) {
    return exp(x, MOD - 2);
}

ll nCk(int n, int k) {
    if (n < k) return 0;
    return mul(facts[n], mul(modInv(facts[k]), modInv(facts[n - k])));
}

ll can(int v, const string& s) {
    string ss = to_string(v);
    char king_me = '?';
    for (int i = 0; i < ss.length(); i++) {
        if (s[i] != '_' && s[i] != 'X') {
            if (s[i] != ss[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        } else if (s[i] == '_') {
            continue;
        } else if (s[i] == 'X') {
            if (king_me != '?' && ss[i] != king_me) {
                return false;
            } else if (king_me == '?') {
                king_me = ss[i];
            } else {
                continue;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    int t = 1;

    while (t-- > 0) {
        string s = fs.next();
        int len = s.length();
        int max_val = (int)pow(10, len) - 1;
        int min_val = (int)pow(10, len - 1);
        if (min_val == 1) min_val--;
        if (s[0] == '0' && s.length() > 1) {
            cout << "0" << endl;
            continue;
        }
        ll ans = 0;
        for (int i = min_val; i <= max_val; i++) {
            if (i % 25 == 0) {
                ans += (can(i, s) ? 1 : 0);
            }
        }
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
